shared_elements: schematic depiction of figures/objects on a flat surface
justification: A shows a single large, carefully modelled winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with elaborate beard, headdress, feathered wings and a held object, rendered in low relief with naturalistic anatomical detail; B shows a scattered field of small, linear, purely schematic outline motifs (boat-like curved forms with vertical strokes, small circles/cup shapes, indistinct lines) distributed across the surface without a dominant figure. Apart from the trivial presence of curved and circular shapes, there is no shared specific motif, relationship or compositional scheme, and the depictive conventions (monumental modelled relief figure vs. tiny linear outline signs) are opposite.
